base_prompt: A club's attendance rose from twenty people to thirty, then fell back to twenty. Explain why the percentage increase and percentage decrease are different. Keep your response near 80 words.
text: The percentage increase and decrease are different because each is calculated using a different starting number. When attendance rose from twenty to thirty, the gain of ten was divided by the original twenty: ten divided by twenty equals 50%. When attendance fell from thirty to twenty, the loss of ten was divided by thirty: ten divided by thirty is about 33.3%. Although the number of people gained and lost was identical, ten represents a smaller proportion of thirty than of twenty.
